editorial:
Imagine you are a tiny mouse just trying to have a peaceful holiday dinner with your family in a cozy country house. That is exactly where you start with this cute story. You get to follow a sweet mouse family who has put so much work into their Christmas decorations and food. The vibe is warm and festive, but everything goes wrong when a group of humans moves in. It turns into a funny game of hide-and-seek where the mice are trying to keep their secret home hidden while the humans get more and more annoyed by the scratching sounds in the walls.

What really works here is the physical comedy and the way the tiny characters interact with big human objects. The pacing stays quick, so you never get bored, though some of the human characters feel a bit one-dimensional. It is the perfect pick for a cozy night in with your kids or parents. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the tiny details of the mouse village. Or, if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for future holiday marathons.
endingExplained: Everything wraps up when the humans finally find the mouse village, but instead of getting rid of them, they realize how hard the mice worked on their Christmas town. The humans decide to leave the mice alone and even leave out some extra treats for them. The movie ends with a big joint celebration where both the humans and the mice share a meal together, proving that everyone can get along during the holidays.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute animals and holiday magic.
